verification_methodology_note:
PRIMARY SOURCE: rulebook.sama.gov.sa (Saudi Central Bank's own official Rulebook portal, the administering/issuing authority's own site), Arabic full-text 'entiresection' view at https://rulebook.sama.gov.sa/ar/entiresection/123 (HTTP 200, live fetch this pass, Drupal 10 site, node 123 = this Regulation, confirmed by the page's own metadata table: 'الرقم: 1/م ش ت' | 'التاريخ (هـ): 1434/4/14' | 'التاريخ (م): 2013/2/24' | 'الحالة: نافذ'). This single URL renders ALL 32 articles across all 3 أبواب (Parts) on one page (Drupal's 'view entire section' feature), located via a link discovered on the regulation's own per-part landing page (https://rulebook.sama.gov.sa/ar/اللائحة-التنفيذية-لنظام-الإيجار-التمويلي, HTTP 200). The Arabic-toggle URL was located via the page's own tag and cross-navigation links on the English page given as the task's starting point (https://rulebook.sama.gov.sa/en/implementing-regulation-finance-lease-law) -- the /ar/ direct slug guess (rulebook.sama.gov.sa/ar/implementing-regulation-finance-lease-law) returned HTTP 404 and was abandoned in favour of the real Arabic-slug URL found via the page's own hreflang metadata. Arabic governs; the English 'entiresection' view (https://rulebook.sama.gov.sa/en/entiresection/123) was fetched and used ONLY for structural cross-verification (article count, Part/Chapter boundaries, and confirming the location and scope of the three amendment footnotes), never as a source of Arabic wording, consistent with this corpus's standing methodology. EXTRACTION METHODOLOGY: the entiresection page is clean, structured, born-digital HTML (no OCR needed) -- each 'المادة ...' is an

immediately followed by a
containing

//
    markup. This was parsed with BeautifulSoup (not naive regex/tag-stripping), locating every h2.page-title in document order (36 total: 1 document-title header, 3 'الباب' Part headers, and 32 'المادة' article headers) and each article's immediately-following field--name-body div. Numbered sub-items rendered as HTML
rows (a recurring SAMA Rulebook formatting convention for enumerated paragraphs, e.g. Articles 2, 4, 9-12, 15, 22, 24) were converted to one line per row, preserving the row's own leading enumerator exactly as published (some articles use '1-' with a following dash, others '1.' with a following dot, and Article 15 additionally uses lettered sub-items أ)/ب)/ت)/ث) -- all of these are genuine source-formatting differences across articles, not extraction artifacts, and are preserved verbatim per article). Every one of the 32 expected Arabic ordinal headers (المادة الأولى .. المادة الثانية والثلاثون) was located with no gaps, and the 3 Part boundaries (الباب الأول: 1-2 | الباب الثاني: 3-11 | الباب الثالث: 12-32) were read directly from the h2 Part-header placement in the same document-order traversal -- matching exactly the 3-part, 32-article structure given in this track's commissioning brief. This was independently cross-checked article-for-article against the English entiresection view (same 36-heading structure: 'Part One Definitions and General Provisions' (Articles One-Two), 'Part Two The Contract' (Articles Three-Eleven), 'Part Three Contracts Register' (Articles Twelve-Thirty-Two)), with zero structural discrepancies. Diacritics/tashkeel are not present in the source (plain modern Arabic typesetting); minor HTML-artifact double-spacing around inline tag boundaries (e.g. around 'من النظام' cross-reference links) was normalized (collapsed to single spaces, and spurious spaces immediately before Arabic punctuation ،/؛/: were removed) without altering any word, digit, or punctuation mark itself. No translation, paraphrase, or legal interpretation was performed on the Arabic text. AMENDMENT VERIFICATION -- ARTICLES 10(3), 17, AND 25(2): the entiresection page renders each amended provision's CURRENT (post-amendment) text with an inline asterisked footnote citing 'قرار معالي المحافظ رقم 93/م ش ت وتاريخ 1441/10/18هـ' (Governor's Decision No. 93/م ش ت, dated 18/10/1441H) -- observed at (1) Article 10's paragraph (3) ('* تم تعديل هذه الفقرة بموجب ...'), (2) Article 17 in its entirety ('تم تعديل هذه المادة بموجب ...'), and (3) Article 25's paragraph (2) ('* تم تعديل هذه الفقرة بموجب ...'). This THIRD amendment locus (Article 25(2)) was NOT part of this track's commissioning brief, which named only Article 10(3) and Article 17 -- see known_unresolved_discrepancies for this correction. All three footnote citations were independently corroborated via SAMA Rulebook's own DEDICATED amendment-decision page, node 3243 (canonical URL: https://rulebook.sama.gov.sa/ar/تعديل-بعض-المواد-في-اللائحة-التنفيذية-لنظام-الإيجار-التمويلي, HTTP 200 after a 301 redirect from the /ar/node/3243 shortlink), titled 'تعديل بعض المواد في اللائحة التنفيذية لنظام الإيجار التمويلي', transmitted by SAMA circular No. (41061552) dated 29/10/1441H (2020/6/20G), which states verbatim: 'نفيدكم بصدور قرار معالي المحافظ رقم 93/م ش ت وتاريخ 1441/10/18هـ والمتضمن تعديل بعض المواد في اللائحة التنفيذية لنظام الإيجار التمويلي وذلك على النحو الآتي: أولاً: تعديل الفقرة (3) من المادة العاشرة ... ثانياً: تعديل المادة السابعة عشرة ... ثالثاً: تعديل الفقرة (2) من المادة الخامسة والعشرون ...' -- i.e. this dedicated decision page independently confirms all THREE amendment loci and gives, for each, the exact NEW ('لتكون بالنص') wording, which matches verbatim (word-for-word) the current text rendered in the entiresection view for all three provisions. This decision page does NOT reproduce the prior/pre-amendment wording of any of the three provisions (see known_unresolved_discrepancies). The English entiresection view independently corroborates the same three amendment loci with the same decision number/date cited in English ('His Excellency the Governor's Decision No. 93/M SH T dated 18/10/1441H'), providing a third independent confirmation of the amendment's existence and exact scope (though not of the Arabic wording itself, per this corpus's standing rule that English is used only for structural/existence cross-checks, never as a source of Arabic text). WAYBACK MACHINE CHECK: the Internet Archive's availability API (archive.org/wayback/available) was queried for the exact Arabic regulation-page URL; it returned exactly one snapshot, dated 2026-01-18 -- long after the 1441H/2020G amendment and therefore not useful for recovering pre-amendment text. No earlier snapshot of this specific URL was found; this is recorded as a documented negative finding, not an assumption that no earlier snapshot could possibly exist anywhere. COMPANION-LAW CROSS-REFERENCE: this Regulation's own Article 1 opens 'مع مراعاة ما ورد في المادة الأولى من النظام' and repeatedly cross-references the base Law by article number throughout (e.g. Articles 2, 8, 9); this track's parent_law field points to sources/finance_lease/law/official_source/finance_lease_law_official_source.json, which itself already documents (in its own known_unresolved_discrepancies) that this companion Regulation exists, is issued under its Article 27, and has been separately amended -- this track is the follow-up ingestion of that already-flagged companion Regulation. No legal text is altered anywhere in this track. Read-only over input; deterministic over outputs.

known_unresolved_discrepancies.description: The prior-research brief that commissioned this track stated the Governor's Decision No. 93/م ش ت (18/10/1441H) amended only Article 10, paragraph (3), and Article 17. Independent re-verification this pass -- via rulebook.sama.gov.sa's own dedicated amendment-decision page (node 3243, titled 'تعديل بعض المواد في اللائحة التنفيذية لنظام الإيجار التمويلي', transmitted by SAMA circular No. 41061552 dated 29/10/1441H = 2020/6/20G) AND independently corroborated by both the Arabic and English entiresection views of the Regulation itself (each carrying an inline amendment footnote on the relevant article/paragraph) -- found that this SAME decision amended a THIRD provision: Article 25, paragraph (2). All three source views (the dedicated amendment-decision node, the Arabic full-text view, and the English full-text view) agree verbatim on citing 'قرار معالي المحافظ رقم 93/م ش ت وتاريخ 1441/10/18هـ' against all three provisions. Accordingly this track classifies Article 25 as معدلة in addition to Articles 10 and 17, correcting the commissioning brief's scope, consistent with this corpus's rule of independently re-verifying rather than propagating an unverified prior claim.

For all three amended provisions (Article 10 paragraph 3, Article 17 in full, Article 25 paragraph 2), rulebook.sama.gov.sa's dedicated amendment-decision page (node 3243) states only the NEW text each provision was amended 'to read as' (لتكون بالنص) -- it does not reproduce the prior, pre-amendment wording. A Wayback Machine availability check for the Arabic regulation page's exact URL (rulebook.sama.gov.sa/ar/اللائحة-التنفيذية-لنظام-الإيجار-التمويلي) returned only a single snapshot dated 2026-01-18 -- long after the 2020 (1441H) amendment, and therefore useless for recovering the pre-amendment text; no earlier snapshot of this specific URL was found available. The pre-amendment wording of all three provisions is therefore NOT recoverable from any source consulted this pass and is not fabricated or guessed at; this is recorded as a documented gap, consistent with this corpus's preference for an honest 'could not confirm' over invented text. The text recorded in this track for Articles 10(3), 17 and 25(2) is the CURRENT (post-1441H-amendment) text only.

Article 1's definitions list defines 'البنك المركزي' (the Central Bank) directly -- i.e. the Regulation's own live text on rulebook.sama.gov.sa already uses the renamed institution's name -- and carries an inline footnote: 'حل اسم "البنك المركزي السعودي" محل اسم "مؤسسة النقد العربي السعودي" بموجب نظام البنك المركزي السعودي رقم (م/36) بتاريخ 1442/4/11هـ.' This is an external renaming effected by a SEPARATE law (the Saudi Central Bank Law, M/36, 11/4/1442H) upon the institution itself, not a textual amendment TO THIS Regulation by a numbered SAMA/Governor amendment decision -- it is therefore NOT counted among this track's معدلة articles and is not part of the confirmed 93/م ش ت amendment. This mirrors the identical, already-documented finding in this corpus's own finance_lease (base Law) track's known_unresolved_discrepancies, with one difference worth flagging: the base Law's own Article 1 text (per BOE and nezams.com) still reads the OLD name 'مؤسسة النقد العربي السعودي' verbatim with no inline footnote, whereas this companion Regulation's text on rulebook.sama.gov.sa has been updated in place to the NEW name 'البنك المركزي' with an explanatory footnote -- i.e. the Law and its Regulation are NOT textually synchronized on this defined term as published, though both denote the same institution post-rename. The footnote sentence itself is not included in this track's article_001 'text' field (consistent with this corpus's convention of keeping amendment/rename citations out of the operative article text and recording them here instead).

This Regulation was issued as an Administrative/Governor's Decision No. 1/م ش ت, dated 14/4/1434H (24/2/2013G per rulebook.sama.gov.sa's own page metadata: 'التاريخ (هـ): 1434/4/14' | 'التاريخ (م): 2013/2/24'), pursuant to Article 27 of the base Finance Lease Law (نظام الإيجار التمويلي, Royal Decree M/48, 13/8/1433H): 'يصدر المحافظ بالاتفاق مع وزير العدل اللائحة التنفيذية لهذا النظام خلال تسعين يوماً من تاريخ صدوره.' rulebook.sama.gov.sa's own page marks this Regulation's status as 'نافذ' (in force). No separate Umm al-Qura Gazette publication citation for this specific Regulation was located this pass (unlike the base Law, which is a Royal Decree with its own Gazette publication and 90-day post-publication commencement clause in its own Article 28); this Regulation's own closing Article 32 states only 'يُعمل بهذه اللائحة من تاريخ نشرها في الجريدة الرسمية' (effective from its own Gazette publication date) without this track independently pinning down that Gazette issue number/date this pass -- recorded here as a documented gap rather than a guessed date.

Consistent with this corpus's established precedent for other SAMA/regulator-level Implementing Regulations (e.g. rett_regulation, vat_regulation, income_tax_regulation), laws.boe.gov.sa is not relied on as the primary source for this companion Regulation; the base Finance Lease Law's own official_source.json (sources/finance_lease/law/official_source/finance_lease_law_official_source.json) already documents that laws.boe.gov.sa was the primary source for the 28 -article base Law (via Wayback Machine, live BOE being unreachable that pass) and separately flagged this companion Regulation as a not-yet-ingested follow-up candidate. This track fulfills that follow-up using rulebook.sama.gov.sa -- SAMA's own official Rulebook portal -- as PRIMARY source directly (HTTP 200, live, bilingual Arabic/English, structured per-article HTML with inline amendment footnotes), which this pass judged the strongest available primary source for this specific instrument; no separate laws.boe.gov.sa lookup for this Regulation was performed given SAMA's own portal is the issuing/administering authority's own primary publication channel and already served this exact role for the base Law's own structural (chapter-heading) cross-check.
